definition: In the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO), HP:0001249 (Intellectual disability) defines a neurodevelopmental phenotype characterized by significantly subnormal general intellectual functioning and cognitive impairment, manifesting as limitations in intellectual and adaptive functioning in developmental disorders.

source.title: Computational analysis of neurodevelopmental phenotypes: Harmonization empowers clinical discovery
